nodes.summary: GLOBAL progress at arbitrary ambient n/shared Γ/actual balanced Δ/process p, qualified ONLY by runtime typing, INITIAL semantic balance and EXISTING persistent availability of ALL declared signatures. Result is actual Idle syntax OR a canonical Step. No frontier/normal form/readiness/Step/fairness/representative is supplied.
nodes.title: Global runtime progress at balanced interfaces given availability

nodes.summary: Closed empty-interface runtime progress, at arbitrary passive-name depth, requires the SAME actual all-declared-service availability. Idle includes waiting replicas/accepts and nil; no termination or scheduler fairness is asserted.
nodes.title: Closed runtime processes are idle or step given availability

nodes.summary: A typed balanced runtime frontier with actual persistent service availability is syntactically Idle OR takes an ACTUAL canonical Step. Shared requests are handled even if all owned keys are done; minimum/peer leaves are derived internally.
nodes.title: Balanced runtime frontiers are idle or step given availability

nodes.summary: Every finite reachable state from an INITIALLY balanced runtime interface retains semantic balance and an ACTUAL faithful advancement trace, not progress.
nodes.title: Multi-step subject reduction at balanced interfaces

nodes.summary: Finite runtime execution from an empty interface preserves exact empty ownership. This safety result does not identify idle replicas with Cong nil.
nodes.title: Multi-step subject reduction at the empty interface

nodes.summary: Finite reachable empty-interface states retain the same qualified progress; this is one-step safety/progress, not all-schedules eventual responsiveness.
nodes.title: Qualified progress at reachable closed runtime states

nodes.summary: Every finite canonical reduction from an initially balanced, available typed runtime retains qualified GLOBAL progress. Safety supplies actual balanced residual ownership/advance trace, and Available.reachable supplies current persistent syntax.
nodes.title: Qualified progress at every reachable runtime state

nodes.summary: From an INITIALLY compatible runtime interface, finite actual reductions retain typing/compatibility and accumulate a trace of faithful semantic advances. Shared/private identity steps introduce no fake external advancement.
nodes.title: Multi-step subject reduction at compatible interfaces

nodes.summary: Actual disjoint same-name linear leaves at an INITIALLY compatible interface have opposite directions and construct a canonical Step. Shapes/nonalias are internally exposed outputs in the GLOBAL proof, not caller readiness hypotheses.
nodes.title: Same-name linear guards at a compatible interface communicate

nodes.summary: Canonical choice selection is identity on an actually runtime-typed root: there is no sum rule, although replication is admitted. No finiteLinear erasure.
nodes.title: Choice selection is the identity on runtime-typed processes

nodes.summary: An INITIALLY semantically balanced runtime interface derives compatibility and retains balance and the exact zero-or-one external advance after ANY Step.
nodes.title: Subject reduction for runtime typing at balanced interfaces

nodes.summary: An empty linear interface is initially balanced/compatible and remains EXACTLY empty through any runtime Step, including private sessions and shared services.
nodes.title: Subject reduction for runtime typing at the empty interface

nodes.summary: From a runtime-typed source at an INITIALLY semantically compatible linear interface, ALL5 canonical Step constructors preserve Γ/n, typing and compatibility. The actual residual interface is unchanged OR has one faithful SemanticAdvance. Shared transfers are exact identity; private projection uses the chosen literal pair.
nodes.title: Subject reduction for runtime typing at compatible interfaces

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
